paragraphs: Epsilon Energy Ltd. (the "Company" or "Epsilon" or "we") was incorporated under the laws of the Province of Alberta, Canada on March 14, 2005, pursuant to the ABCA. The Company is extra-provincially registered in Ontario pursuant to the Business Corporations Act (Ontario). Epsilon is a North American on-shore focused independent natural gas and oil company engaged in the acquisition, development, gathering and production of natural gas and oil reserves. On February 14, 2019, Epsilon's registration statement on Form 10 was declared effective by the United States Securities and Exchange Commission and on February 19, 2019, we began trading in the United States on the NASDAQ Global Market under the trading symbol "EPSN."

At December 31, 2025, Epsilon's total estimated net proved reserves were 86.4 Bcf of natural gas reserves, 9.3 MMBbls of oil reserves, and 2.4 MMBbls of NGL reserves. Epsilon holds leasehold rights to approximately 101,265 gross (54,044 net) acres. The Company has natural gas production in the Appalachian Basin Pennsylvania and oil, natural gas liquids and natural gas production in the Powder River Basin in Wyoming, the Permian Basin in Texas and New Mexico, and the Western Canadian Sedimentary Basin in Alberta, Canada.

On November 14, 2025, Epsilon acquired Peak Exploration & Production LLC and Peak BLM Lease LLC and their subsidiaries (together, "Peak") for total consideration of $88.5 million consisting of 1) issuance of 5,681,489 common shares valued at $27.6 million, 2) contingent consideration of up to 2,500,000 common shares valued at $10.6 million, and the settlement of $50.3 million of debt. The contingent consideration was settled on November 19, 2025, through the issuance of 2,234,847 common shares for $10.6 million. The acquired assets primarily include operated and non-operated production and leasehold interests in the core of the Powder River Basin in Wyoming. As part of the acquisition, the Company added 17 full-time employees from Peak.
The results of operations attributable to the Peak acquisition have been included in the Company's consolidated financial statements as of the closing date of the acquisition.

We conduct operations in the United States through our wholly owned subsidiaries Epsilon Energy USA Inc., an Ohio corporation, or Epsilon Energy USA; Epsilon Midstream, LLC, a Pennsylvania limited liability company, or Epsilon Midstream; Epsilon Operating, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company; Dewey Energy GP LLC, a Delaware limited liability company; Peak Exploration & Production LLC, a Delaware limited liability company; Peak BLM Lease LLC, a Delaware limited liability company; Peak Powder River Resources, LLC, a Wyoming limited liability company (the licensed operator in the state of Wyoming); Peak Energy Operating #2, LLC, a Colorado limited liability company; Willow Springs Development, LLC, a Colorado limited liability company; Peak Powder River Acquisition, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company; and Altolisa Holdings, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company.

Substantially all the Pennsylvania acreage (4,878 net) is dedicated to the Auburn Gas Gathering System ("Auburn GGS") located in Susquehanna County, Pennsylvania for a 10-year term expiring in 2033 under an operating agreement whereby the Auburn GGS owners charge a fixed gathering and compression rate which is adjusted annually by the CPI-U All Urban Consumer Price Index published by the US Bureau of Labor Statistics. We own a 35% interest in the Auburn GGS which is operated by a subsidiary of Williams Partners, LP. In 2025, we paid $3.5 million (after elimination) to the Auburn GGS to gather and treat our 9.4 Bcf of natural gas production in Pennsylvania ($2.4 million after elimination was paid to the Auburn GGS to gather and treat our 5.7 Bcf in 2024), including the fees paid to our subsidiary, Epsilon Midstream.

Our principal executive office is located at 500 Dallas Street, Suite 1250, Houston, Texas 77002, and our telephone number at that address is (281) 670-0002. Our registered office in Alberta, Canada is located at 14505 Bannister Road SE, Suite 300, Calgary, AB, Canada T2X 3J3.
● During the year ended December 31, 2025, Epsilon's realized natural gas price was $2.98 per Mcf,
excluding the impact of hedges, a 66% increase from $1.80 for the year ended December 31, 2024.

● Total natural gas sales for the year ended December 31, 2025 were 9.4 Bcf, a 65% increase from the 5.7 Bcf sold for the year ended December 31, 2024, driven by new wells and curtailed wells returning to production.
● Gathered and delivered 40.5 Bcf gross (14.2 Bcf net to Epsilon's interest) during the year, or 111 MMcf/d through the Auburn GGS.
● In 2025, 4 gross (0.24 net) wells were turned on line in January 2025 and 3 gross (0.04) wells were turned on line in March 2025.

● During the year ended December 31, 2025, Epsilon's realized price for all Permian Basin production was $49.19 per Boe, excluding the impact of hedges, an 8% decrease from the $53.52 per Boe for the year ended December 31, 2024.
● Total sales for the year ended December 31, 2025, including oil, natural gas, and natural gas liquids, were 212 Mboe, an 18% decrease from the 259 MBoe sold for the year ended December 31, 2024.

headings: Risks Related to Oil and Natural Gas Reserves
Our business is dependent on oil and natural gas prices, and any fluctuations or decreases in such prices could adversely affect our results of operations and financial condition.

Our long term commercial success depends on our ability to find, acquire, develop and commercially produce oil and natural gas reserves, the failure of which could result in under-use of capital and in losses.
Our reserve estimates may be inaccurate, and future net cash flows as well as our ability to replace any reserves are uncertain.
Risks Related to Stage of Development, Structure and Capital Resources
Substantial capital, which may not be available to us in the future, is required to replace and grow reserves.
The borrowing base under our credit facility may be reduced in light of commodity price declines or reserve changes, which could limit us in the future.
The terms of our revolving credit facility may restrict our operations, particularly our ability to respond to changes or to take certain actions.
Depending on forces outside our control, we may need to allocate our available capital in ways that we did not anticipate.
We may issue debt to acquire assets or for working capital.
Future equity transactions could result in dilution to existing stockholders.
Results of our drilling are uncertain, and we may not be able to generate high returns.
Extensive government legislation and regulatory initiatives could increase costs and impose burdensome operating restrictions that may cause operational delays.
Our corporate structure could result in incremental tax burden in certain circumstances.
Our operations are currently geographically concentrated and therefore subject to regional economic, regulatory and capacity risks.
Delays in business operations may reduce cash flows and subject us to credit risks.
We depend on third-party operators and our key personnel, and competition for experienced technical personnel may negatively affect our operations.
Our leasehold interests are subject to termination or expiration under certain conditions.
We may incur losses as a result of title deficiencies.
We may be exposed to third-party credit risk, and defaults by third parties could adversely affect us.
We may not be insured against all of the operating risks to which we are exposed.
Risks Related to Commodity Prices, Hedging and Marketing
Natural gas and oil prices fluctuate widely, and low prices for an extended period would likely have a material adverse effect on our business.
Hedging transactions may limit our potential gains or cause us to lose money.
Market conditions or operation impediments may hinder our access to natural gas and oil markets or delay our production.
Investor sentiment towards climate change, fossil fuels, and sustainability could adversely affect our business and our share price.
We are subject to complex laws and regulations, including environmental regulations that can have a material adverse effect on the cost, manner and feasibility of doing business.
Environmental and health and safety risks may adversely affect our business.
We may be subject to interruptions or failures in our information technology systems.
We are subject to cybersecurity risks. A cyber incident could occur and result in information theft, data corruption, operational disruption and/or financial loss.
We are a "smaller reporting company" and as a result of the reduced disclosure requirement applicable to smaller reporting companies, our common shares may be less attractive to investors.

If we fail to establish and maintain proper disclosure or internal controls, our ability to produce accurate financial statements and supplemental information or comply with applicable regulations could be impaired.
Because of the natural decline in production from existing wells, our success depends on the Anchor Shippers' economically developing the remaining Marcellus Shale reserves in Pennsylvania.
Because of the large supply of gas, and limited availability of transportation out of Pennsylvania, our gas is subject to a price differential.
We compete with other operators in our gas gathering energy businesses.
Several of our assets that have been in service for many years may require significant expenditures to maintain them. As a result, our maintenance or repair costs may increase in the future.
We are exposed to the credit risk of our customers and counterparties, and our credit risk management will not be able to completely eliminate such risk.
The financial condition of our natural gas gathering businesses is dependent on the continued availability of natural gas supplies and demand for those supplies in the markets we serve.
Our operations are subject to operational hazards and unforeseen interruptions.
Risks Related to Our Business Combination
paragraphs: You should carefully consider the risks and uncertainties described below, together with all of the other information and risks included in, or incorporated by reference into this report, including our consolidated financial statements and the related notes thereto, before making any financial decisions relating to Epsilon.

Revenues, profitability, liquidity, ability to access capital and future growth prospects are highly dependent on the prices received for oil and natural gas. The prices of these commodities are subject to wide fluctuations in response to relatively minor changes in supply and demand. Historically, the markets for oil and natural gas have been volatile, and this volatility may continue in the future. The volatility of the energy markets generally makes it extremely difficult to predict future oil and natural gas price movements. Also, prices for oil and prices for natural gas do not necessarily move in tandem. Declines in oil or natural gas prices would not only reduce revenue but could also reduce the amount of oil and natural gas that can be economically produced and therefore potentially lower natural gas and oil reserve quantities. If the oil and natural gas industry experiences low prices, we may, among other things, be unable to meet all our financial obligations or make planned expenditures.

Substantial and extended declines in oil and natural gas prices may result in impairments of proved natural gas and oil properties or undeveloped acreage and may materially and adversely affect our future business, financial condition, cash flows, results of operations, liquidity or ability to finance planned capital expenditures. To the extent commodity prices received from production are insufficient to fund planned capital expenditures, spending will be required to be reduced, assets could be sold or funds may be borrowed to fund any such shortfall.

Oil and natural gas operations involve many risks that even a combination of experience, knowledge and careful evaluation may not be able to overcome. Our long term commercial success depends on our ability to find, acquire, develop and commercially produce oil and natural gas reserves. Without the continual addition of new reserves, any existing reserves that we may have at any particular time and the production from those reserves will decline over time as those reserves are exploited. A future increase in our reserves will depend not only on our ability to explore and develop any properties we may have from time to time, but also on our ability to select and acquire suitable producing properties or

prospects. We cannot assure you that we will be able to locate and continue to locate satisfactory properties for acquisition or participation. Moreover, if we do identify such acquisitions or participations, we may determine that current markets, terms of acquisition and participation or pricing conditions make such acquisitions or participations uneconomic. We cannot assure you that we will discover or acquire further commercial quantities of oil and natural gas.

Future oil and natural gas exploration may involve unprofitable efforts, not only from dry wells, but also from wells that are productive but do not produce sufficient net revenues to return a profit after drilling, operating and other costs. Completion of a well does not ensure a profit on the investment or recovery of drilling, completion and operating costs. In addition, drilling hazards or environmental damage could greatly increase the cost of operations, and various field operating conditions may adversely affect the production from successful wells. These conditions include delays in obtaining governmental approvals or consents, shut-ins of connected wells resulting from extreme weather conditions, insufficient storage or transportation capacity or other geological and mechanical conditions. While diligent well supervision and effective maintenance operations can contribute to maximizing production rates over time, production delays and declines from normal field operating conditions cannot be eliminated and can be expected to adversely affect revenue and cash flow levels to varying degrees.

paragraphs: The following discussion is intended to assist in the understanding of trends and significant changes in our results of operations and the financial condition of Epsilon Energy Ltd. and its subsidiaries for the periods presented. This section should be read in conjunction with the audited consolidated financial statements as of December 31, 2025 and 2024 and for the years then ended together with accompanying notes.

Epsilon Energy Ltd. (the "Company") is a North American onshore focused independent natural gas and oil company engaged in the acquisition, development, gathering and production of natural gas and oil reserves. Our areas of operations are the Appalachian Basin in Pennsylvania, the Powder River Basin in Wyoming, the Permian Basin in Texas and New Mexico, and the Western Canadian Sedimentary Basin in Alberta, Canada.

At December 31, 2025 our total estimated net proved reserves were 86.4 Bcf of natural gas reserves, 9.3 MMBbls of oil reserves, and 2.4 MMBbls of NGL reserves, and we held leasehold rights to approximately 101,265 gross (54,044 net) acres. We have natural gas production from our non-operated wells in Pennsylvania and natural gas, natural gas liquids, and oil production from our operated and non-operated wells in the Permian, Powder River, and Western Canadian Sedimentary Basins.

We are committed to disciplined capital allocation which could include shareholder returns in the form of dividends and/or share buybacks. We plan to maintain a strong balance sheet and liquidity position to allow us to opportunistically invest in both our existing project areas and potential new projects.
Our Pennsylvania ("PA") assets are supported by our 35% ownership in the Auburn GGS.
We have a substantial remaining drillable location inventory within our existing leaseholds in Pennsylvania, Wyoming, and Texas.

On November 14, 2025, Epsilon acquired Peak Exploration and Production LLC and Peak BLM Lease LLC and their subsidiaries (together, "Peak") through a business combination. The acquisition added 284 gross (60 net) wells, including 105 gross (45 net) operated wells, and 60,945 gross (39,566 net) acres located in Campbell, Converse and Johnson Counties, Wyoming.

On December 11, 2025, Epsilon divested Dewey Energy Holdings, LLC, a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company to an undisclosed private buyer. The assets sold included approximately 964 Mcfe/d (60% natural gas) of production and approximately 6,400 net deep acres and 2,200 net shallow acres of leasehold, all located in Dewey County, Oklahoma.

During 2025, we realized net loss of $5.8 million as compared to net income of $1.9 million for 2024. This included a $19.3 million loss in Q4 2025 on the sale of our Anadarko Basin assets in Oklahoma, which provides potential tax benefits that may be utilized going forward.

At December 31, 2025, our total estimated net proved developed reserves were 109,444 MMcfe, a 69% increase from December 31, 2024. The increase is mainly attributable to Wyoming reserves acquired from the Peak acquisition.

At December 31, 2025, our total estimated net proved reserves were 156,037 MMcfe, a 86% increase from December 31, 2024. The increase is mainly attributable to Wyoming reserves acquired from the Peak acquisition.

Our standardized measure of discounted future net cash flows as of December 31, 2025 and 2024 was $156.1 million and $50.7 million, respectively. This measure of discounted future net cash flows does not include any estimate for future cash flows generated by our gathering system assets.
The following review of operations for the periods presented below should be read in conjunction with our consolidated financial statements and the notes thereto.
During the year ended December 31, 2025, revenues increased $20.1 million, or 64%, to $51.6 million from $31.5 million during the year ended December 31, 2024.

paragraphs: Epsilon Energy Ltd. (the "Company" or "Epsilon" or "we") 係於加拿大亞伯達省根據亞伯達省公司法 (ABCA) 於 2005 年 3 月 14 日成立，並於安大略省根據商業公司法 (Ontario) 進行跨省註冊。Epsilon 為一家專注於北美陸上地區的獨立天然氣與石油公司，從事天然氣與石油儲量的取得、開發、集輸與生產。2019 年 2 月 14 日，Epsilon 的 Form 10 登記聲明經美國證券交易委員會核准生效，並於 2019 年 2 月 19 日開始在美國 NASDAQ Global Market 交易，股票代碼為 "EPSN."

2025 年 12 月 31 日，Epsilon 的總估計淨證實儲量為 86.4 十億立方英尺 (Bcf) 的天然氣儲量、9.3 千萬桶 (MMBbls) 的石油儲量，以及 2.4 千萬桶 (MMBbls) 的 NGL 儲量。Epsilon 擁有約 101,265 美英畝 (54,044 美英畝) 的租賃權。本公司在賓夕法尼亞州的阿巴拉契亞盆地有天然氣生產，在懷俄明州的 Powder River Basin、德克薩斯州與新墨西哥州的 Permian Basin，以及加拿大亞伯達省的西部加拿大沉積盆地均有石油、天然氣液體與天然氣生產。

2025 年 11 月 14 日，Epsilon 收購 Peak Exploration & Production LLC 與 Peak BLM Lease LLC 及其子公司 (合稱 "Peak")，總對價為 88.5 百萬美元，包含 1) 發行 5,681,489 張普通股，價值 27.6 百萬美元；2) 可變現對價最高達 2,500,000 張普通股，價值 10.6 百萬美元；以及結清 50.3 百萬美元的債務。可變現對價於 2025 年 11 月 19 日透過發行 2,234,847 張普通股，價值 10.6 百萬美元結清。所取得的資產主要包括在懷俄明州 Powder River Basin 核心地區的經營與非經營性生產與租賃權益。此筆收購中，本公司增聘 Peak 的 17 名全職員工。
Peak 收購所產生的營運成果已納入本公司於收購完成日的合併財務報表中。

本公司透過 wholly owned 子公司 Epsilon Energy USA Inc.（Ohio 公司）或 Epsilon Energy USA；Epsilon Midstream, LLC（Pennsylvania 有限責任公司）或 Epsilon Midstream；Epsilon Operating, LLC（Delaware 有限責任公司）；Dewey Energy GP LLC（Delaware 有限責任公司）；Peak Exploration & Production LLC（Delaware 有限責任公司）；Peak BLM Lease LLC（Delaware 有限責任公司）；Peak Powder River Resources, LLC（Wyoming 有限責任公司，為懷俄明州的經許可經營者）；Peak Energy Operating #2, LLC（Colorado 有限責任公司）；Willow Springs Development, LLC（Colorado 有限責任公司）；Peak Powder River Acquisition, LLC（Delaware 有限責任公司）；以及 Altolisa Holdings, LLC（Delaware 有限責任公司）在美國進行營運。

substantially all 的賓夕法尼亞州土地 (4,878 美英畝) 用於 Susquehanna 縣的 Auburn Gas Gathering System ("Auburn GGS")，為期 10 年，至 2033 年到期，根據經營協議，Auburn GGS 所有者收取固定集輸與壓縮費用，每年根據美國勞工統計局發佈的 CPI-U All Urban Consumer Price Index 調整。本公司在 Auburn GGS 擁有 35% 的權益，由 Williams Partners, LP 的子公司經營。2025 年，本公司支付 3.5 百萬美元 (扣除後) 給 Auburn GGS 以集輸與處理賓夕法尼亞州 9.4 Bcf 的天然氣生產 (2024 年支付 2.4 百萬美元 (扣除後) 給 Auburn GGS 以集輸與處理 5.7 Bcf 的天然氣生產)，包含支付給本公司子公司 Epsilon Midstream 的費用。
本公司主要營業據點位於德州休士頓市 Dallas Street 500 號 1250 號套房，郵遞區號 77002，該地址電話為 (281) 670-0002。本公司在加拿大艾伯塔省之登記辦事處位於 Calgary 市 Bannister Road SE 14505 號 300 號套房，郵遞區號 T2X 3J3。

排除避險影響後，較2024年12月31日財年每股1.80美元成長66%。

● 2025年12月31日財年，Epsilon對全得克薩斯州盆地生產的實現價格為每Boe 49.19美元，排除避險影響後，較2024年12月31日財年每Boe 53.52美元下降8%。
● 2025年12月31日財年總銷售量，包括石油、天然氣與天然氣液體，為212千桶等值油（Mboe），較2024年12月31日財年銷售的259千桶等值油下降18%。

paragraphs: 以下討論旨在協助瞭解我們營運成果及財務狀況的趨勢與重大變動，適用於 Epsilon Energy Ltd. 及其子公司在所列期間的表現。本節應與截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日及 2024 年 12 月 31 日的經審計合併財務報表，以及相關附註一併閱讀。
Epsilon Energy Ltd.（"本公司"）為一家專注於北美陸上地區的獨立天然氣與石油公司，從事天然氣與石油儲量的取得、開發、集輸與生產。本公司營運區域為賓夕法尼亞州的阿巴拉契亞盆地、懷俄明州的 Powder River 盆地、德克薩斯州與新墨西哥州的 Permian 盆地，以及加拿大艾伯塔省的西部加拿大沉積盆地。
截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，本公司總計估計淨證實儲量為 86.4 十億立方英呎的天然氣儲量、9.3 千萬桶的石油儲量，以及 2.4 千萬桶的 NGL 儲量，並持有約 101,265 細項（54,044 網路）英畝的租賃權。本公司在賓夕法尼亞州的非經營井有天然氣生產，在 Permian、Powder River 及西部加拿大沉積盆地的經營與非經營井則有天然氣、天然氣液體及石油生產。
本公司致力於嚴謹的資本配置，可能包括以股息及/或股票回購形式回饋股東。本公司計畫維持強固的資產負債表與流動性，以利我們在現有項目區域與潛在新項目中進行機會性投資。
本公司賓夕法尼亞州（"PA"）資產由本公司在 Auburn GGS 的 35% 股權所支撐。
本公司在賓夕法尼亞州、懷俄明州與德克薩斯州現有租賃權中，仍有大量可鑽探的儲備位置。
2025 年 11 月 14 日，本公司透過企業併購取得 Peak Exploration and Production LLC 及 Peak BLM Lease LLC 及其子公司（合稱 "Peak"）。此次併購增加了 284 細項（60 網路）口井，包括 105 細項（45 網路）經營井，以及位於懷俄明州坎伯蘭、康弗斯及約翰遜縣的 60,945 細項（39,566 網路）英畝租賃權。
2025 年 12 月 11 日，本公司將 Dewey Energy Holdings, LLC（本公司全資子公司）出售給未具名的私人買家。出售資產包括約 964 Mcfe/d（60% 為天然氣）的生產量，以及約 6,400 網路深層英畝與 2,200 網路淺層英畝的租賃權，所有資產均位於奧克拉荷馬州 Dewey 縣。
2025 年本公司實現淨損失 5.8 百萬美元，較 2024 年淨收入 1.9 百萬美元為之。此損失包含 2025 年第四季因出售位於奧克拉荷馬州的 Anadarko Basin 資產而產生的 19.3 百萬美元損失，該交易可能提供未來可使用的稅務好處。
2025 年 12 月 31 日，本公司總計估算之淨已證開採儲備為 109,444 MMcfe，較 2024 年 12 月 31 日增加 69%。此增加主要係因取得來自 Peak 收購之懷俄明州儲備。
2025 年 12 月 31 日，本公司總計估算之已證儲備為 156,037 MMcfe，較 2024 年 12 月 31 日增加 86%。此增加主要係因取得來自 Peak 收購之懷俄明州儲備。
本公司於 2025 年 12 月 31 日及 2024 年 12 月 31 日之標準化折現後未來淨現金流測算值分別為 156.1 百萬美元及 50.7 百萬美元。此折現後未來淨現金流測算值未包含本公司集氣系統資產未來產生現金流之預估。
以下對所列期間營運之回顧，應與本公司合併財務報表及相關附註同時閱讀。
2025 年 12 月 31 日為結算日之年度，營業收入增加 20.1 百萬美元，或成長 64%，達 51.6 百萬美元，較 2024 年 12 月 31 日為結算日之年度 31.5 百萬美元為之。

headings: 與石油及天然氣儲備相關的風險
本公司業務依賴石油及天然氣價格，若價格波動或下降，可能會對本公司營運成果及財務狀況產生不利影響。
本公司長期商業成功取決於本公司尋找、取得、開發及商業性生產石油及天然氣儲備的能力，若無法達成，可能會導致資本使用不足及產生虧損。
本公司儲備估計值可能不準確，未來淨現金流以及本公司更換任何儲備的能力均存在不確定性。
與開發階段、結構及資本資源相關的風險
未來可能需要大量資本以更換及擴大儲備，而本公司可能無法取得此類資本。
因商品價格下跌或儲備變動，本公司信貸協議下的貸款額度可能降低，這可能會限制本公司未來的發展。
本公司週轉信貸協議的條款可能限制本公司營運，特別是本公司對應變數或採取特定行動的能力。
視外在因素而定，我們可能需要以未預期的方式運用現有資金。
我們可能發行債務以取得資產或用於營運資金。
未來的股權交易可能導致現有股東權益稀釋。
我們鑽井作業的結果具有不確定性，且可能無法產生高報酬。
廣泛的政府立法與監管措施可能增加成本，並施加嚴格的營運限制，可能導致營運延誤。
本公司組織結構在特定情況下可能導致額外稅負。
本公司營運目前地理上集中，因此面臨區域經濟、監管及容量風險。
營運延誤可能減少現金流，並使我們面臨信用風險。
我們依賴第三方營運者及關鍵員工，且對經驗豐富技術人員的競爭可能對我們的營運產生負面影響。
我們的租賃權益可能因特定條件而終止或到期。
我們可能因所有權瑕疵而產生損失。
我們可能面臨第三方信用風險，且第三方違約可能對我們產生不利影響。
我們可能未投保所有所面臨的營運風險。
與商品價格、避險及行銷相關的風險
天然氣與石油價格波動極大，且若低價持續一段時間，可能對我們的業務產生重大不利影響。
避險交易可能限制我們的潛在獲利，或導致我們虧損。
市場狀況或營運障礙可能妨礙本公司接觸天然氣與石油市場或延宕本公司生產。
投資人對氣候變遷、石化燃料及永續性的觀感，可能不利於本公司業務及本公司股價。
本公司受複雜法律與法規所規範，包括環境法規，這些法規可能對本公司營運成本、方式及可行性產生重大不利影響。
環境及健康與安全風險可能對本公司業務產生不利影響。
與網路安全相關的風險
本公司可能面臨資訊科技系統中斷或故障的風險。
本公司受網路安全風險影響。網路事件可能發生，導致資訊竊取、資料毀損、營運中斷及/或財務損失。
與內部控制相關的風險
本公司為一「較小規模申報公司」，因適用於較小規模申報公司的減免揭露要求，本公司普通股可能對投資人較不具吸引力。
若本公司未能建立並維持適當的揭露或內部控管，本公司產生準確財務報表及補充資訊或符合適用規範之能力可能受影響。
與集氣系統相關之風險
因現有井口之產能自然下降，本公司之成功取決於Anchor Shippers經濟開發賓夕法尼亞州剩餘的Marcellus Shale儲量。
因氣體供應量龐大，且賓夕法尼亞州外運輸能力有限，本公司氣體可能面臨價格差異。
本公司在氣體集氣能源業務中與其他經營者競爭。
本公司部分資產已運作多年，可能需要大量支出以維護，因此未來維護或修補成本可能增加。
本公司面臨客戶及交易對手之信用風險，且本公司信用風險管理無法完全消除此風險。
本公司天然氣集輸業務之財務狀況取決於天然氣供應之持續可用性及所服務市場對該等供應之需求。
本公司營運受操作風險及未預見中斷之影響。
與本公司業務合併相關之風險
paragraphs: 您應仔細審閱下列所描述的風險與不確定性，並配合本報告中包含的所有其他資訊與風險，包括我們的合併財務報表及其相關附註，再做任何與 Epsilon 相關的財務決策。

營業收入、獲利能力、流動性、取得資金的能力及未來成長前景，高度依賴所收到的石油與天然氣價格。這些商品的價格會因供應與需求的微小變動而大幅波動。歷史來看，石油與天然氣市場一直相當波動，這種波動可能在未來持續存在。能源市場的波動性通常使預測未來石油與天然氣價格變動變得極其困難。此外，石油價格與天然氣價格不一定同步變動。石油或天然氣價格下跌不僅會減少收入，也可能減少可經濟性生產的石油與天然氣數量，因此可能降低天然氣與石油儲備量。
石油與天然氣價格大幅且持續下跌，可能會導致已證實的天然氣與石油資產或未開發土地的減損，並可能對我們未來的業務、財務狀況、現金流、營運成果、流動性或籌資預計資本支出的能力產生重大且不利的影響。若從生產所得的商品價格不足以支應預計的資本支出，則可能需要減少支出、出售資產或借款以彌補任何缺口。
石油與天然氣運營涉及許多風險，即使結合經驗、知識與謹慎評估，也可能無法克服。我們的長期商業成功取決於我們找到、取得、開發並商業性生產石油與天然氣儲備的能力。若沒有持續增加新儲備，我們在任何特定時間點所擁有的任何現有儲備及其生產量，將會隨著這些儲備被開發而逐漸減少。未來我們儲備的增加不僅取決於我們對所擁有財產的探勘與開發能力，也取決於我們選擇並取得合適生產財產或
潛力。我們無法保證我們將能尋找並持續尋找適合的財產以進行取得或參與。此外，若我們確實識別出這些取得或參與機會，我們可能認為目前市場、取得或參與條款或價格條件使這些取得或參與不具經濟性。我們無法保證我們將發現或取得進一步的商業石油與天然氣儲量。

未來石油與天然氣探勘可能涉及不具盈利性的努力，不僅來自乾井，也來自生產性但無法產生足夠淨收入以彌補鑽井、運營及其他成本的井。鑽井完成並不保證投資獲利或彌補鑽井、完井與運營成本。此外，鑽井風險或環境損害可能大幅增加運營成本，而各種現場運營條件可能對成功井的生產造成不利影響。這些條件包括取得政府批准或同意的延遲、因極端天氣條件導致相關井關閉、儲存或運輸容量不足或其他地質與機械條件。雖然勤勉的井監督與有效的維護運營可以有助於長期最大化生產率，但來自正常現場運營條件的生產延遲與下降無法消除，並可能對收入與現金流產生不同程度的不利影響。
